title: Santa Hat
wikitext: {{Infobox mousehat |name = Santa Hat |image = Santa Hat.png |achievement = Networking |ad = Reach a 5-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with 10 people. |price = {{Price|2000}} }} The '''Santa Hat''' is a [[Hats|hat]] that can be purchased from the [[Abandoned House]] for {{Price|2000}} after earning the "Networking" [[Achievements|Achievement]] (reach a 5-heart [[Friendship|friend]] level with 10 people). It can also be obtained from [[Desert Festival#Emily's Outfit Services|Emily's outfit services]] at the [[Desert Festival]]. There is a ≈2% chance to receive the gender-neutral outfit with the Santa Hat. ==Notes== * The Santa Hat outfit also includes the [[File:Shirt035.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Shirts|Fancy Red Blouse]] and [[File:Shorts.png|24px|link=]] [[Tailoring#Pants|Shorts]] (dyed RGB value 139,255,99). ==References== Male players have 47 possible outfits (1/47 ≈ 2.13%), while female players have 48 possible ones (1/48 ≈ 2.08%). See Content\Data\MakeoverOutfits.xnb. [[wikipedia:RGB color model|RGB]] refers to "Red,Green,Blue". ==History== {{History|1.0|Introduced.}} {{History|1.6|Purchase price increased from {{Price|1000}} to {{Price|2000}}.
